dedupe_keys.name: poles jrc global energy system simulation model

description: POLES-JRC is a global energy model that covers the whole energy balance, from final energy demand, through transformation and power production, to primary supply and trade of energy commodities, run by the European Commission's Joint Research Centre with partners GAEL lab at Université Grenoble Alpes and Enerdata. It represents 66 regions, including all G-20 countries, detailed OECD and the main non-OECD economies, on a yearly time step, and assesses the contribution of fossil fuels, nuclear and renewables and of energy vectors to future needs. It also computes greenhouse gas emissions, endogenously for the energy and industry sectors and by linkage with specialist models for agriculture, land use and air pollution. It has been used for several Directorates-General of the European Commission and for national authorities. Access: the JRC page publishes the 2018 update of the model documentation and a reference list; no download of the model, its inputs or its licence terms is shown, so access to the model itself should be treated as by request to the partners. Caveats: annual national and regional resolution only, with no network or hourly grid detail. It suits long-term energy scenario and policy analysis and provides context for infrastructure capacity planning; it relates to the TIMES and MESSAGEix models in the catalogue.
